mapper.sql: warehouse_id, company_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, postal_code, address1, address2, description, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse ( company_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, postal_code, address1, address2, description, use_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{postalCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{description}, #{useYn}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse SET warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND company_id = #{companyId}
